messages:
Frank (CEO): Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands: leadership wants a short, shareable "why we win / why we lose" we can put in the board packet. Keep to concrete asks and impacts.

Hannah (PM): From interviews and deal reviews: Wins: 1) Dedicated + SLA, 2) predictable committed pricing, 3) VPC/KMS. Losses: 1) total cost vs self-hosting for infra-heavy customers, 2) lack of an on-prem/offline option for regulated industries, 3) limited rollback/pinning UX causing renewal friction.

Maya (CRO): Sales color: buyers sign when we give throughput numbers + migration plan. We lost two pilots where procurement couldn't justify the premium compared to owning GPUs.

Ellie (CS): Support sees two churn triggers: latency spikes under burst and quality regressions after model swaps. Customers ask for per-request model ids in logs and easy pin-to-old-version.

Liam (Eng): Short-term mitigations: add a "pin model" toggle in Console, enable canary rollouts with automatic fallback on regressions, and emit model-id in traces. Long-term: on-prem appliance with KMS integration. I'll draft an RFC.

Ben (SRE): We can produce a one-pager of expected throughput/latency per Dedicated SKU for sales to share. That will reduce prospect pushback on performance guarantees.

Ravi (Data): On instrumentation: I'll tag closed deals with 'reason_won'/'reason_lost' and map to support categories. Quick counts (since 2025-09-01): sla_commit=11, pin_model=8, need_onprem=6. I'll push the CSV link tonight.

Hannah (PM): Leadership asks: what single feature if shipped in 90 days moves the needle most? My pick: on-prem/offline bundle + audit logs for finance/health regulated deals. Second: model pinning & automated rollback to cut renewal risk.

Frank (CEO): Agree on prioritization but want concrete evidence. If Sales can point to 2-3 near-term deals requiring on-prem, we'll consider fast-tracking it. Otherwise, focus on pin/rollback.

Maya (CRO): I'll surface two live deals this week that hinge on on-prem and share anonymized RFP lines.

Ellie (CS): I'll paste three anonymized support snippets referencing rollback and latency.

ops-bot: created doc playbooks/win-loss/q4-2025 by @Hannah

Hannah (PM): Action items: Maya -> live deals (Tue), Liam -> RFC for pin/rollback + telemetry (Fri), Ben -> perf one-pager (Wed), Ravi -> full tag counts & avoidable-churn model (Tue). Owners acknowledged?

Maya (CRO): Acknowledged.

Liam (Eng): Acknowledged.

Ben (SRE): Acknowledged.

Ravi (Data): Acknowledged, will include confidence bands.

Frank (CEO): Thanks all. Hannah, synthesize into the follow-up email and include links to drafts for the board packet.
